sourcePlan.scope: The original tracked lease and workspace DB files and targeted operational archived-list checks ran against the public E candidate on three different selected Linux runner PostgreSQL 17 service containers. The product reader was invoked after synthetic role/membership transitions. The actual package-defined node loaders/flags, auth/deployment marker and tracked migrations were used. UI/official paired builds, production and device behavior are separately scoped.
